# Grahko

> Grahko takes local shops and small businesses in India from offline to online. We build mobile-friendly websites and Android apps, set up the shop on Google Maps (Google Business Profile), set up WhatsApp Business (catalog, auto-replies, automatic bookings and orders), and keep helping after launch. IIT Delhi-led engineering team based in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad (Delhi NCR), working with clients across India in Hindi and English.

## Who it is for
Electricians, plumbers, grocery (kirana) shops, medical stores, salons and parlours, clinics, coaching centres, schools, dhabas and restaurants, clothes shops, lawyers and CAs, gyms, and other small businesses.

## Plans (one-time cost, no lock-in, everything in the client's name)
- Website only: mobile website, call and WhatsApp buttons, address and map, 1 year hosting.
- Website + App: everything above, an Android app in the client's name, Google Maps listing and WhatsApp Business setup, 3 months of free help.
- Everything: website, app and automatic WhatsApp bookings/orders, with monthly updates and a report; the monthly plan can be stopped any month.
- Big projects: school portals, medical store billing, lawyer/CA client systems, priced on the work.
Current prices and offers are on https://grahko.in/#pricing

## How it works
1. Talk on WhatsApp, phone or video call. 2. Pay half to start, the rest when the work is done, with a receipt. 3. See the first design in 3–4 days. 4. Website live in about 7 days (apps take 15–20 days for Google Play approval).
